# Jira Trigger

## Summary

Learn how to use the Jira Trigger node in n8n.

Learn how to use the Jira Trigger node in n8n. Follow technical documentation to integrate Jira Trigger node into your workflows.

[Jira](https://www.atlassian.com/software/jira) is a proprietary issue tracking product developed by Atlassian that allows bug tracking and agile project management.

{% hint style="info" %}
**Credentials**

Refer to the [Jira credentials documentation](/integrations/builtin/credentials/jira) for authentication information for this node.
{% endhint %}

For usage examples and templates to help you get started, refer to n8n's [Jira trigger integrations](https://n8n.io/integrations/jira-trigger/) page.
{% endhint %}
